summary: Singly-linked list destructor. Walks the list headed by *this, freeing each node's payload only when the per-node flag at node+8 is set, then freeing the node itself. After the walk, zeroes the four-dword container fields (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) and returns the last FreeWrapper result. Structural twin of LinkedListDestructor_1db0 (00491db0) per the prelabel cluster_copy.

operations.description: Iterate the singly-linked list starting at head *this, following the next pointer stored at each node's +4 field until a null node ends the walk.
Per node, test the flag byte at node+8; only when it is nonzero is the node's payload released.
When the flag is set, release the payload pointer stored at node+0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf after its payload and next pointer have been consumed; its return value becomes the loop result.
After the walk, reset the container head to null by zeroing all four dword fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8 and 0xC.
Return the result of the last node-free call (FreeWrapper_7bcf), as retained by the loop increment.

unresolved: Payload type at node+0 and the meaning of the flag byte at node+8 are caller-defined; the exact ownership rule is unknown here
Whether payload release is required (versus a simple leak guard) depends on the caller's allocation scheme
